title: Senior Quantitative Business Analyst – Risk & Performance

business_context.summary: This role supports Clearwater’s Risk & Performance business by translating quantitative risk analytics into a usable, client-ready product offering. It sits at the intersection of product definition, risk methodology, market data, and implementation for VaR and Stress Testing capabilities.
business_context.problem_solved: It helps ensure that risk analytics products are correctly specified, methodologically sound, and reliably delivered in production so clients and stakeholders get robust VaR and stress testing functionality.

analyst_notes: This is a hybrid risk-product role focused on making VaR and stress testing capabilities workable, well-specified, and defensible in production. The strongest candidate would be comfortable translating between quants, engineers, vendors, and stakeholders, with enough quantitative fluency to document methodology and enough product discipline to turn it into clear requirements. It differs from a pure quant role because delivery and specification are central, and from a pure BA role because the domain is explicitly quantitative risk analytics.

title: Solutions Engineer - Risk Analytics

business_context.summary: This role exists within a pre-sales / solution engineering team to help sell a complex institutional risk analytics platform. It translates quantitative risk concepts into client-ready value narratives, demos, and objections handling for sophisticated buy-side prospects.
business_context.problem_solved: Pre-sales persuasion in a technical domain and turning prospect/client feedback into actionable product input.
evidence: This role exists to help win and support sales of a complex institutional risk analytics platform by translating quantitative risk concepts into client-ready value narratives and demonstrations.
The business problem is twofold: 1. **Pre-sales persuasion in a technical domain.**
The role also serves as a bridge between prospects/clients and the product team, turning objections and feature requests into actionable product input.
The role sits in the **Americas Solution Engineering / PreSales** organization and supports sales across asset managers, asset owners, and hedge funds.

position_function.function_mix_description: Primarily a technical sales-support role with deep risk analytics expertise; it is client-facing and presales-oriented rather than software engineering or post-sale implementation.
position_function.reason: The JD explicitly calls the team PreSales, and the responsibilities center on demos, discovery, RFPs, POCs, objections handling, and explaining modeling assumptions. That combination fits a solutions engineer embedded in the sales cycle.

analyst_notes: This is a client-facing pre-sales solutions engineering role for an institutional risk analytics platform. Success depends on being able to explain complex risk concepts clearly, earn trust with sophisticated buy-side prospects, and feed market feedback back into product. It is different from a pure risk analyst role because the output is persuasion and deal support, and different from engineering because it is not building the platform.
